investment_strategy: Barbell A.I. strategy over 12–36 months: overweight resilient A.I. platform leaders for compounding growth and cash-flow durability (Alphabet, Microsoft) while adding a small, high-upside semiconductor onshoring beneficiary (Microchip). analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility where possible, strong growth, and fast momentum; integrated news/trend fit (A.I. platforms, on-device/edge, CHIPS Act). Excluded AAPL (bearish trend, slower momentum) and META (declining growth) versus chosen names.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Cautiously optimistic for 12–36 months: A.I. a durable multi-year driver; expect volatility from earnings, regulation, and geopolitics. Favor high-quality A.I. platforms and U.S.-beneficiary chipmakers while managing capex and policy-cycle risks.
